sum: A fully modernized, modular, EE/EET-compatible rebuild of Weimer's classic Valen NPC mod, featuring explicit CRE field writes, v1.0 format guards, and load-order-safe 2DA patches.
no: Install before SolaufeinEE. The cross-mod interjections in Solaufein's Core component require valenj.dlg to already be present at install time. Must also be installed before eet_end, cdtweaks, and stratagems.
ic: Hard conflict with legacy (non-EE) Valen mods. Install before SolaufeinEE for cross-mod interjections.

co.no: Explicit CRE field writes via EE_SET_CRE_FIELDS, v1.0 format guard on all binary writes, corrupted field repair (Dialogue resref, known-spells table), explicit gender write, deprecated-opcode cleanup, vampire hunter script resolution, and cross-platform lowercase normalization.

co.n: Give More Creatures Protection From Level Drain & Undead
co.tp2n: Give More Creatures Protection From Level Drain & Undead
co.no: Independent tweak. Scans every v1.0 CRE in override/ and grants LEVIMM to inherently-undead-immune creatures and PRODEAD to qualifying priests and paladins. Party NPCs are excluded.

conflicts.reason: Cannot coexist with older legacy non-EE versions of the Valen mod.

advisories.reason: Solaufein's Component 10 checks for valenj.dlg at install time and compiles cross-mod interjections when present. Install Valen first to enable them.

rec.tip: Install Valen before Solaufein for the cross-mod interjections.

cl.m: Added to catalog as modernized EE/EET rebuild; 2-component layout with independent extras.
